# KLUB Pilates Studio (Keep Living Under Balance)

KLUB is a premium reformer Pilates studio in Limassol city center, Cyprus,
opening September 2026. Small-group reformer classes and private 1-to-1
sessions, taught in English and Greek by founder Izzy Nicolaou.
Canonical site: https://klub.cy

## What we offer
- Small-group reformer Pilates classes: Reformer Fundamentals, Reformer Flow, Reformer Power
- Private 1-to-1 reformer sessions
- Beginner-friendly; new-to-Pilates intro offer

## Prices (EUR)
- Drop-in class: €20
- Intro pack (2 classes): €32
- Monthly: 4 classes €120, 8 classes €200, Unlimited €280
- Flexi packs: 5 classes €110, 10 classes €200
- Private 1-to-1: single session €80, 5-session pack €375, 10-session pack €700
